title: ContextRoute
description: Result of a directory-style sequential context route walk (M40). Records each resolved segment so callers can prove only the walked path was loaded.

resolved.description: True when every segment resolved to a context node.

inode_refs.description: Inode IDs in scope at the resolved route (pointers only, never source).

failed_segment.description: First segment that did not resolve, when resolved is false.
